name: The Ranch at Laguna Beach
insider_take: This clifftop hideaway sits on 87 acres of pristine wilderness, making it the largest resort property in all of Laguna Beach – a rare find in this artsy coastal enclave.
whats_special: The Ranch occupies the former site of a 1960s trailer park that has been transformed into Laguna Beach's only true resort destination. Its elevated position offers unobstructed Pacific Ocean views, while the property's extensive trail system connects directly to Crystal Cove State Park's 2,400 acres of protected coastline.
pro_tip: Book the Harvest Restaurant's chef's table experience – Executive Chef Tim Guiltinan sources ingredients from the resort's own organic garden and partners with local Laguna Beach farmers for ultra-fresh California cuisine.
dont_miss: The resort's Tree House – a 1,000-square-foot meeting space built 15 feet above ground among native oak trees. Also explore the nearby Laguna Art Museum, housed in a 1918 building and featuring the world's finest collection of California art, just 10 minutes down the scenic Pacific Coast Highway.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with panoramic Pacific views
Rustic-chic ranch aesthetic with authentic California charm
Direct beach access to pristine Laguna Beach coastline
Exceptional farm-to-table dining featuring local ingredients
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive coastal location
Limited parking availability during peak seasons
